title: Common definitions for a2dlc run (protocol state machine, Stages -1 to 7)

role.description: Roles of §3 of the protocol that run as a command. The Deterministic Oracle, the Router and the Indexer are the core, not roles.

family.description: Declared model family (claude, gemini, openai, …) or script for a deterministic role. The core records it; it cannot prove which model answered.

stage.description: Protocol stages that a2dlc run runs (§5). 6 (integration: consumer matrix and migration linter, config.integration) and 7 (progressive delivery: the plan as an artifact, intent.delivery) run the part that fits in the binary; the platform executes the plan.

path.description: Path as the role saw it inside the container (/in/… or /out/…).

cost.description: What the role's CLI reported (e.g. total_cost_usd of claude -p --output-format json). Without a report, null; CB-03 only sums what was reported and says so.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt tokens, cache included. When the cache counters are present, input_tokens >= cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens (JSON Schema cannot compare two fields: internal/run rejects a response that breaks it as invalid_response).

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Part of input_tokens served from the prompt cache. Absent when the CLI did not report it.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Part of input_tokens written to the prompt cache. Absent when the CLI did not report it.
